Latin Small Letter I With Acute Alt Code and Symbol

The Alt code for Latin Small Letter I With Acute is 161. Hold Alt, type 161 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt. Latin Small Letter I With Acute also has the Unicode codepoint U+00ED, so you can type it with Alt+237 on Windows, search for U+00ED in macOS's Character Viewer, use í in HTML, or \00ED in CSS. If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly — the Alt key method requires a physical numpad. Copy the Latin Small Letter I With Acute character from this page when you need it in a form, chat message or document that does not accept Alt codes. HTML also defines the named entity í for Latin Small Letter I With Acute, but the numeric form í is safer when compatibility is uncertain.

How to type latin small letter i with acute on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 1 6 1 on the numeric keypad.
  4. Release Alt. The Latin Small Letter I With Acute character (í) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type latin small letter i with acute on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Latin Small Letter I With Acute. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Latin Small Letter I With Acute" and click the character to insert it.

How to use latin small letter i with acute in code

  • HTML: or , also
  • CSS: content:"\00ED"; ()
  • Python: \u00ED or chr(0xED)
  • JavaScript: \u00ED or String.fromCodePoint(0xED)
  • JSON: "\u00ED"

Frequently asked questions

What is the Alt code for Latin Small Letter I With Acute?

The legacy Alt code for Latin Small Letter I With Acute is 161. Hold Alt, type 1 6 1 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt.

How do I type í without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as í, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+237 not work?

Alt+237 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Latin Small Letter I With Acute?

The Unicode codepoint for Latin Small Letter I With Acute is U+00ED. You can use this value in HTML as í, in CSS as \00ED, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type í on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+00ED, then click it.
